publicConclusion: Candidato AGAMA preparado e ensaiado, com controle de calibração vertical. As realizações permanecem em avaliação física e não foram promovidas a modelos de equilíbrio certificado.

haloGridValidation.reference: actual AGAMA final-halo Multipole evaluated at independent random meridional positions

limits: SCM same-grid iteration convergence is not DF/grid/physical stability convergence
Model changes masses/profiles and omits gas; legacy-to-new difference is not initialization alone
Halo fixed field is unsoftened while particle interactions are Plummer
N-body long runs use GPU f32 and approximate BH energy diagnostic; short backend comparisons are not long-term f64 convergence
No artificial damping, velocity resets or decorative spirals
